|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[General Grievous (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-D-generalgrievous_ai-2022-01-15.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V3-D-generalgrievous_ai-2022-01-15-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V3-D-generalgrievous_ai-2021-09-04.gif]], 4 September 2021) → [[File:V3-D-generalgrievous_ai-2022-01-15-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V3-D-generalgrievous_ai-2022-01-15.gif]], 15 January 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[General Grievous (ALT)]]): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-generalgrievous_ai91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/generalgrievous_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC no longer serves it (the next day the PC moved this PNG to the repository's “hires” folder and published a GIF made from it). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Raithal Operative”. Text: “Any stolen lightsaber may deploy on Grievous. Once per game, Grievous may steal a lightsaber from opponent's Lost Pile. Unless alone, may lose 1 Force to return Grievous (and your cards on him) to hand from a site you control. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[General Grievous (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 4 September 2021<ref name="img-generalgrievous_ai1c540d0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/generalgrievous_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/1c540d0df3ebba5b7a98f95e23a8f04039234a08 commit 1c540d0] (4 September 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/generalgrievous_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC replaced its high-resolution PNG upload of the day before with the GIF made from it for Holotable (the PNG was moved to the “hires” folder); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (703×980 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Raithal Operative”. Text: “Any stolen lightsaber may deploy on Grievous. Once per game, Grievous may steal a lightsaber from opponent's Lost Pile. Unless alone, may lose 1 Force to return Grievous (and your cards on him) to hand from a site you control. Immune to attrition < 4.”
